Digital pre-orders for Stage Tour are now available on PlayStation®5! PlayStation®Plus members save 10% when they pre-order the Digital Edition ahead of launch on December 10, 2026.
No instrument controller required. Rock out with a DualSense® wireless controller, plug in a compatible legacy guitar controller, or take the stage with the new range of official Stage Tour hardware. Play solo or with up to four players locally, online, or cross-platform.

Featuring 90+ officially licensed songs, 180+ authentic in-game Gibson, Epiphone and Kramer guitars, 50+ bandmates, and more. Get ready to rock out to Metallica, The Rolling Stones, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Olivia Rodrigo, blink-182, Paramore, Slipknot, Muse, and many more.

Pre-order Stage Tour now on PlayStation®5.

See what makes The Wolf Among Us Remastered the definitive edition: Improved lighting, updated animation, refined environments, the all-new Noir Mode, never-before-seen playable deleted scenes, behind-the-scenes video interviews, and more.
This remaster is a proper return to Fabletown, for Telltale's acclaimed noir narrative thriller, inspired by DC's award-winning Fables comic series. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, The Wolf Among Us Remastered brings Bigby Wolf's first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and more detail than ever before.
Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown. Myths and legends live secretly among us and every choice carries consequences.
Fairytales are real. Murder is just the beginning.
Available October 29, 2026.
